name: Product Sync — list or update on each connected account

nodes.name: Approved Listing
nodes.notes: Called by the backend once a human approved the listing. Carries the product and which accounts it goes to.

nodes.name: Get Account Credentials
nodes.notes: Keys live encrypted in the database, one set per connected shop. This is the only place they come back out, and the backend logs every read. 423 means the business is suspended or that account's sync is paused.

nodes.name: Lazada product/create
nodes.notes: Lazada takes form-encoded parameters, one of which is the XML payload.

nodes.name: Report Listing
nodes.notes: Each account reports its own result, so the dashboard shows which shops took the listing and which refused it.
